display_long_description:
Welcome to Orang Oasis, a vibrant Gorilla Tag fangame that drops you into a playful paradise built for movement, chaos, and nonstop fun. This isn’t just another map—it’s a full-on oasis where momentum rules, creativity shines, and every leap feels rewarding.

Set in a lush, sun-soaked environment, Orang Oasis blends natural terrain with stylized structures designed specifically for Gorilla Tag–style locomotion. Towering palms, smooth rock formations, open caverns, and flowing pathways create an arena where wall-climbing, launching, and clutch escapes feel incredibly fluid. Whether you’re racing across open spaces or juking other players through tight routes, the map is built to keep movement fast, skill-based, and satisfying.

Orang Oasis is designed with both casual players and competitive taggers in mind. New players can quickly get the hang of the terrain, while experienced gorillas can master advanced routes, shortcuts, and momentum tech. Every surface, slope, and jump is intentionally placed to reward smart movement and creative plays—no two chases ever feel the same.

Beyond movement, Orang Oasis focuses heavily on atmosphere. Warm colors, lively visuals, and an upbeat tone make the map feel alive and welcoming, while still keeping that iconic Gorilla Tag energy. It’s a place that feels fun to hang out in, whether you’re grinding movement skills, playing with friends, or just goofing around between rounds.
